newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE TURNOVER UP 6.75PCT MO/MO IN AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE TURNOVER UP 6.75PCT MO/MO IN AUGUST.

text.p: Turnover at the Athens stock exchange's main market rose by 6.75 percent or 7.71 billion drachmas to 122.08 billion month-on-month in August, Ionian Research said in a statement.
Turnover rose 7.51 percent month-on-month to 12.22 billion drachmas in the bourse's parallel market in August, it said.
The marketability of shares listed in the bourse's main market stood at 3.47 percent in August compared to 3.84 percent in July. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
